Subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/Infra workshop (60–90m) — attendee alignment

Hi Samir & Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful to understand HealthSync's latency targets and the spike patterns you see during billing runs. Per our conversation, the next best step is a 60–90 minute technical workshop with our ML/Infra engineers and your platform team to:

- Walk through a short architecture map of your inference path
- Validate performance targets and KV/prefix caching opportunities
- Review quantization/throughput tradeoffs for peak windows
- Agree on a mutual action plan and success criteria

Could you confirm which of these three times works for your team? All times below are PDT:

1) Tue Jul 1 — 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Jul 2 — 13:00–14:30
3) Thu Jul 3 — 09:00–10:30

Please also confirm the attendee roster (names + roles). For the session we'll bring: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer, infra/serving), Monica Patel (Customer Success - runbooks & handoff), and myself for product context.

I've attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan template for you to review. If none of the slots work, tell us a couple of windows and we can re-propose.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0148

Attachments: redwood-tdx-agenda-draft.pdf (7 KB - agenda outline), healthsync-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (12 KB - MAP template)

Ava — thanks for the summary. Priya and I reviewed the slots with the infra leads. Our preferred time is option 2 (Wed Jul 2 — 13:00–14:30 PDT).

Attendees from HealthSync:
- Priya Rao (Director, Platform Engineering) — will lead the session
- Neil Ocampo (Staff ML Engineer) — will cover model serving specifics
- Marco Li (SRE) — interested in autoscaling/latency SLOs

One ask: can you include a short 10-minute segment on how Redwood handles KV cache warming and cold-start behavior? That is one of the main risks we want to validate.

I'll accept the calendar invite once you push it.

Thanks,
Samir

- expected hit-rate tradeoffs for short-lived sessions vs long-running jobs
- mitigations: proactive cache prefill strategies we can run during your billing ramp windows

We'll prepare a short micro-demo (animated slides + perf numbers) and leave time for Neil to dig into any specifics.

1) 5m — goals & success criteria (Priya + Ava)
2) 15m — HealthSync architecture overview (Samir/Neil)
3) 20m — Redwood runtime & KV caching behavior (Ben)
4) 20m — perf targets, quantization options, and tradeoffs (Ben + Ava)
5) 15m — ops/runbook & handoff (Monica)
6) 10–15m — Q&A / next steps

Monica — can you drop the calendar invite and include the drive link to the pre-read? I'll attach the micro-demo deck.
